name: CTC Carousel
author: UjW0L

sections.description:
CTC Carousel is a lightweight and easy-to-use Gutenberg block plugin designed for displaying image carousels. It allows you to showcase images in an interactive slider, making it perfect for photo galleries, product highlights, or any visual content.

Features:

  • Responsive design to fit any screen size.
  • Autoplay functionality to enhance user engagement.
  • Simple image management through the Gutenberg block editor.
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized.

CTC Carousel is focused on simplicity and ease of use, helping you create beautiful image displays without unnecessary complexity.

What’s Next

Explore my other WordPress projects:
– CTC Gallery 🎨 – Four different types of Galleries in same plugin.
– PicTweak 📸 – Capture, edit, and upload stunning photos with ease with webcam, all within WordPress.”

  • CT Commerce Lite 🛒 – A block-based eCommerce plugin.

How to Use

  1. Open a post or page in the Gutenberg editor.
  2. Search for the CTC Carousel block in the block library.
  3. Add the block to your page or post.
  4. Upload images or select them from your media library.
  5. Adjust settings like autoplay and transition speed in the block settings panel.
  6. Publish your post or page to display the image carousel on your site.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ctc-carousel directory, or install the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory through your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Gutenberg editor, add the CTC Carousel block, and start building your image carousel!
sections.faq:
1. Can I display videos or other content in the carousel?

No, the CTC Carousel is specifically designed for displaying images.

2. Is autoplay mandatory?

No, autoplay is optional and can be toggled on or off in the block settings.

3. Is the carousel responsive?

Yes, the CTC Carousel adapts to all screen sizes and devices.
